ios.desc:
Make ordinary places more fun.

Travel Bingo is a family-friendly spotting game for real life. Pick a place, choose how you want to play, and get kids looking around, noticing details, and staying engaged wherever the day takes you.

It works on road trips, at restaurants, in airports, at hotels, at the grocery store, in waiting rooms, around the house, at parks, museums, libraries, zoos, aquariums, theme parks, and more.

No setup. No accounts. No internet required. Just open the app and start playing.

Two ways to play

Bingo Mode
Play classic tap-to-mark bingo with randomized boards, a FREE center space, and fun win patterns like Line, Four Corners, Plus, X, and Blackout. It is great for car rides, short waits, restaurant downtime, and quick family challenges.

Scavenger Hunt Mode
Choose a checklist-style hunt for longer outings and slower-paced adventures. Pick 10, 15, 25, or Full Deck, then track progress as players find items in the real world.

Built for families

Travel Bingo is made for kids, parents, caregivers, teachers, homeschool families, and anyone who wants an easy way to make waiting time, errands, travel days, and everyday outings more enjoyable.

Play solo or use pass-and-play with up to 4 players on one device. Each player gets their own board or hunt progress, making it easy for siblings, friends, and family members to play together without needing multiple devices.

40+ places to play

Travel Bingo includes illustrated tiles across 41 categories, including:

Road trips
US License Plates
Airport
Hotel
Restaurant
Grocery Store
Neighborhood
Backyard Explorer
Park & Playground
Nature Trail
Zoo
Aquarium
Theme Park
Beach
Library
Museums
Hospital
Rainy Day
House
Camping
Farm
Garden
Colors & Shapes
Five Senses
Letters & Numbers
And more

Whether you are driving across town, waiting for food, sitting at an appointment, exploring a museum, or trying to rescue a rainy afternoon, there is probably a category that fits.

Easy to customize

Real life is unpredictable, so Travel Bingo lets you adjust the game before and during play.

Preview items before starting. Swap out bingo tiles. Reorder scavenger hunt lists. Remove items from Full Deck hunts. Modify active games when something does not fit the place you are in.

That means less frustration and more “I found it!”

Photo proof for scavenger hunts

Kids can attach photo proof to scavenger hunt items using the camera or photo library. Photos are stored on-device, with an optional setting to save

quotes.text:
If you've ever played travel bingo as a kid, you know it simply involves looking out the window and spotting objects along the road. After submitting my app Travel Bingo for Kids, it was rejected because it apparently contains intense simulated gambling.

They required me to change the minimum age for the app before accepting it. I can see the point with regular bingo if awards like coins or jewels are given... but travel bingo, which is basically checking off boxes of what you see on the side of the road?

Anyways, with my next update I'll attempt to submit it at 4+ again and see what happens.

If you want to check out the app it is here:
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/travel-bingo-for-kids!/id733677465?mt=8
